.info_form{

    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 15px;

    font-weight: 500;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.info_form form .info_checkbox{
    display: flex;
    /* justify-content: space-between; */
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.info_form form input[type="checkbox"],
.info_form form input[type=radio] {
    /* border: 1px solid #BFC3C8; */
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    margin-right: 8px;
    background: #f2f2f2;
    position: relative;
}

.info_form form input[type="checkbox"]::before,
.info_form form input[type=radio]::before{
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    background-color: #B94A48 !important;
} 

.info_form form .info_item{
    min-width: 32%;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

/* .info_form form .form-check.form-check-inline {
    margin-right: 50px;
} */

.info_form form .form-check-label {
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 15px;
}

.info_form form .form-group {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.info_form form .star{
    color: #B94A48;
}

.info_form form .form_label{
    /* font-weight: 500; */
    display: block;
    line-height: 1;
}

.info_form form span.form_label{
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.info_form form .form-check-label a{
    color: #E87722;
}

.info_form form .form-check-label a:hover{
    color: #808080;
}

.info_form form small.form-text {
    color: #666666;
}

.info_form form .form-control {
    background: #f2f2f2;
    min-height: 40px;
}

.info_form form .form-control:focus{
    background: #f2f2f2;
}

.info_form form .info-border{
    border-bottom: 1px solid #666666;
}

.info_form form .info-head h2{
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 35px;
    color: #395382;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.info_form form .info-head h3{
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 20px;
    color: #222222;
    margin: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;

@media( max-width: 991px ) {

        min-width: 46%;
    }
}

@media( max-width: 575px ) {

        min-width: 100%;

<h3 style="font-weight: 300;"><strong style="font-style: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">How to add Two Rivers Cooperatives Cash Bids page as an icon on your device:</span></strong></h3>
<p style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"> </span><strong style="font-style: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Apple iPhone or iPad: </span></strong></p>
<ul style="font-weight: 400;">
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Open the Safari or Internet app.<br />
</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Type “TwoRivers.Coop” in the search box and select “Go”</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">On TRC’s home page, scroll down to the “Cash Bids” button and click on it.    This will open the Cash Bids page.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Tap on the “Share” icon, a square with an arrow pointing upwards, at the bottom of the page.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Select “Add to Home Screen.”  You may need to scroll up to view all options. </span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">The link button will be named “Cash Bids – Two Rivers Cooperative,” but you can edit the name.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Tap “Add” in the upper right-hand corner.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Now, a button with the TRC logo will appear on your home screen linking to the Cash Bids page.</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">If you need further instruction, you can watch this short </span><b><a href="https://youtu.be/BJpk6X5n-Sc" style="font-style: inherit;">video</a></b><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">.</span></p>
<p style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"> </span><strong style="font-style: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Android:</span></strong></p>
<ul style="font-weight: 400;">
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Open the Chrome or Internet app.<br />
</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Type “TwoRivers.Coop” in the search box and select “Go”</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">On TRC’s home page, scroll down to the “Cash Bids” button and click on it.    This will open the Cash Bids page.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Tap the menu icon </span><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">(3 dots in upper right-hand corner) and tap “Add to Home Screen.”</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">The name field is editable, so you can change the name you want to be associated with this website. </span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Tap “Add” to complete the process.</span></li>
<li style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">Now, a button with the TRC logo will appear on your home screen linking to the Cash Bids page.</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit;">If you need further instruction, you can watch this short <b><a href="https://youtu.be/kaXWohkYy0A" style="font-style: inherit;">video.</a></b>  </span></p>
